subject: Human Evolution
title: The First Family
description: A fast breakdown of The First Family for builders.

hook.text: A year after Lucy, Johanson's team found something even rarer: fossils of 13 individuals at one site.

buildup.text: Site AL 333 in Ethiopia held adults and children, all Australopithecus afarensis, all from the same era.

discovery.text: Dubbed the 'First Family,' they showed that early hominins lived and traveled in social groups.

twist.text: How did they all die together? A flash flood is the best guess—quick burial preserved them all.

climax.text: One catastrophe gave science more data on early hominins than decades of careful searching.

quiz.question: What made the 'First Family' discovery special?
